rationale: Prepared bacon must not use pork derivation as is-a ancestry
Prepared breadcrumbs must not use bread derivation as is-a ancestry
Spelling equivalence must not be encoded as an is-a edge
Coconut milk uses the specific milk-alternative branch
Coffee creamer preserves its specific creamer parent
Coffee pod preserves its reviewed coffee parent
Generic foie gras must not assert duck-only ancestry
Grits use cereal ancestry and non-satisfying corn derivation
Inactive cream-class duplicate has no primary edge
Lime juice uses juice ancestry and non-satisfying fruit derivation
Nut butter is a spread and not a lexical butter subtype
Pear marmalade uses preserve ancestry and non-satisfying pear derivation
Soy sauce uses the specific sauce branch
Stock paste is a concentrated stock base
Inactive chocolate-class duplicate has no primary edge
